name: cobalt
description: Save videos, audio and pictures from the web. No ads, no trackers.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Settings and keys. Put cookies.json or keys.json in the config folder inside it.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: cobalt web app and API, published on host as 6144

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you type in your browser. Download links are made from it, so it must be right. It starts as localhost, which only works on this device. For other devices, change `localhost` to your server IP. Keep the port at 6144.
